scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.build:sidecar: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build:binary --workspace=backend
scripts.tauri: npm run build --workspace=backend && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "tauri dev"
scripts.tauri:build: npm run build:sidecar && npm run build --workspace=frontend && tauri build
